name: prism-kappa
title: Prism Kappa
purpose: Decides whether one object may enter the Prism under its kappa label, the content address of UOR-Foundation/kappa-registry (feat/rewrite-after-poc, commit 618f477745e601f1bf1bd5cc62aed6fea4c8936d): an axis name, a colon and the digest in lowercase hex. A label is read as kappa-registry's Kappa::parse reads it, and an object is admitted only when the browser re-derived the very digest the label names.

fields.name: colon
fields.means: whether the label has the colon that separates its axis from its digest

fields.name: axis
fields.means: the axis the label names before its colon, one of kappa-registry's six, or anything else

fields.name: digits
fields.means: whether the digest has exactly twice its axis's digest length in hex digits

fields.name: hex
fields.means: whether every digest digit is lowercase hex (0-9, a-f)

fields.name: digest
fields.means: the one word the request carries: the browser re-derived the label's digest from the object's bytes (match), derived another (mismatch), could not derive it on this host (uncomputed), or found a SHA-1 collision

read: colon, axis, digits and hex are read by the model from the label itself; only digest is a word on the request line

guarantees.why: a label without its colon names no axis (KappaParseError::NoColon)
only kappa-registry's six axes are content addresses (KappaParseError::UnknownAxis)
a digest of the wrong length for its axis is no address on it (KappaParseError::WrongDigitCount)
the wire form is lowercase hex only; any other digit refuses (KappaParseError::BadHex)
bytes that do not re-derive to their label never enter under it (KappaParseError::DigestMismatch)
content that collides on SHA-1 is refused (KappaParseError::CollisionDetected)
a digest the browser could not re-derive is never taken as verified
a well-formed label whose digest the browser re-derived is refused only for naming an unknown axis
